method.method_draft: First describe the image contents, then convert only the atom-bond graph to SMILES. From the drawing, transcribe the organic fragment as R1-NH-C(=O)-O-H, replacing R1 with `*` and omitting explicit hydrogens unless needed. This gives `*NC(=O)O`. Then include the separate `:B` species as `[B]`, joined with a dot for disconnected components, yielding `*NC(=O)O.[B]`.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个有机片段，左侧为 R¹ 连接到带有 H 的 N；该 N 连接到一个羰基碳，羰基碳向下双键连接 O，并向右单键连接一个带 H 的 O。右侧另有一个与有机片段不成键的 :B。图中还有若干弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：只把原子-键连接关系转成 SMILES。R¹ 用通配符 * 表示，因此有机片段为 *-N-C(=O)-O，即 *NC(=O)O；右侧独立的 :B 按方法写作 [B]。两个组分不相连，用点号分隔，得到 *NC(=O)O.[B]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the depicted molecular skeleton: an R1 substituent attached to an NH, the N bonded to a carbonyl carbon, that carbon double-bonded to O and single-bonded to an OH oxygen; a separate base fragment labeled :B is present, with curved arrows and dashed/arrow annotations to be ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and specifically says to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: an unspecified R/R1 attachment can be encoded as wildcard `*`; amide/carbamate connectivity N-C(=O)-O is written `NC(=O)O`; disconnected species are separated by `.`; the base label B is represented as `[B]`. Ignore electron-pushing arrows because they are not bonds in the requested structure.
